notes: μή keeps *not* under rule 69 because μηκέτι is rendered non-negatively as *any longer*; rules 41 and 59 would empty it only if the second word carried the negation itself.
οἱ governs the expressed vocative ἄνδρες but the ASV writes it no determiner and no address word, so it is unrepresented under rules 23, 31 and 89 and the participle keeps the relativizer.
The supplied *that* goes to the infinitive δεῖν under rule 85, not to βοῶντες.
